kokoro.notes: Current baseline. Test Hindi pronunciation and Hinglish code-switching.

indic-parler-tts.notes: Prompt-controlled speaker identity, pitch, pace and delivery. Hugging Face access may require accepting model conditions.

indic-speak.notes: Purpose-built code-mixed Indian speech. Requires gated Hugging Face access and license review; include required attribution and comply with service-hosting restrictions.

indicf5.notes: Reference-audio-conditioned synthesis. Use only recordings with explicit speaker permission; requires a reference clip and its exact transcript.

piper-hi.notes: Hindi voice model cards identify CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 training data. Do not use in client/commercial output until model-weight and generated-audio rights are authoritatively clarified.

approval_rule: No engine or voice is production-approved until the user explicitly selects it for that character.
